answer.explanation: The contrast shows that Leo becomes talkative and funny when he feels comfortable with people.

solutionStrategy: Use the time/condition contrast at first versus after he feels comfortable to infer the change.
solutionSteps: Notice Leo is quiet at first.
Read what happens after he feels comfortable.
Translate tells funny stories into a personality clue.
Reject anger, inability, and fear because they are unsupported.
Select A because it combines talkative behavior with humor.
